title: Driving Modes and Mode Features
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on the availability and experience of different driving modes, with clear praise in some examples and many other mentions that are descriptive, exploratory, or unclear in sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the ability to switch among drive modes, enjoying options such as sport, comfort, and efficient, and related features like changing lights, supportive seat bolsters, and relaxing mode behavior.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention learning, adjusting to, or preferring different mode setups, but the examples do not clearly show overall satisfaction or dissatisfaction with the drive modes themselves.

limitations: Many examples are undetermined, so the sample often mentions drive modes without a clearly expressed evaluation.
Some sampled fragments touch adjacent features such as ambient lighting, seat bolsters, or general vehicle distinctiveness rather than the drive modes alone.
The selected fragments are stratified samples and not representative estimates of all G70 owner views.
